description: Fullscreen for the cockpit, and only that. The main window is OS-decorated, so maximise and minimise come from the titlebar and need no grant at all — a capability gates JS calls, not the chrome Windows draws. Fullscreen is the one thing no titlebar offers, so it is the one thing granted. Its own file rather than a line in default.json because default.json covers both windows: the splash is undecorated and draws its own strip, and it must not gain the ability to go fullscreen on a first run. The cockpit renders model-influenced HTML, which is why every grant here stays this narrow.
